meta.coordinates: camera frame: x right+, y up+, z forward along the optical axis; bearing right+

camera.note: hfov is an assumed value; pinhole model, square pixels

calibration.note: Pretrained Depth Anything V2 metric model used as-is, with no per-camera or per-scene calibration. Accuracy has not been measured on this camera; check against a tape measure before relying on absolute values.

smoothing.method: median(window) -> EMA(alpha) on z; approach = EMA(alpha) of -dz/dt

corridor.definition: 5th-percentile metric depth inside a strip straight ahead; no class needed. Misses obstacles below the strip.

clock.t: seconds since the script started (or video time with --source)
clock.capture_unix_s: time.time() just after the frame was read; wall clock, comparable across machines if their clocks are synced
clock.capture_monotonic_s: time.monotonic() at the same moment; comparable only between processes on this machine
clock.latency_ms: capture to fused record ready (before the prioritizer); excludes camera and driver buffering before read() returned

meta.frames: one entry per processed frame, including frames with no objects
